title: Cholesterol in Fast Food
text:
The question
Can we predict cholesterol accurately from other nutritional information and the restaurant a food comes from? Which nutrients are the most influential? Answering these questions will inform consumers of fast food and spread awareness on fast food health. Our response variable is cholesterol (mg), and some of the important candidate predictors include company, calories, total fat, saturated fat, sodium, carbs, fibers, sugars, and proteins.
